subject.title: [Bug]: Self-closing reasoning tags drop following visible assistant text

question: Should maintainers accept a narrow self-closing-tag repair now, or make one shared stateful tokenizer the required owner for complete and streamed reasoning-tag parsing?
rationale: The active cross-cutting candidate fixes both delivery paths but identifies grammar ownership and malformed-markup tolerance as a permanent design choice that cannot safely be inferred from this one regression.

options.title: Adopt a shared tokenizer
options.body: Create one stateful reasoning-tag tokenizer and migrate both complete-response and streaming consumers so visibility decisions cannot diverge.

options.title: Accept the bounded repair
options.body: Land a narrow self-closing-tag fix after explicitly accepting the remaining separate-parser grammar limits and proving both output paths.

options.title: Pause for a replacement
options.body: Keep the issue and linked candidates open while a maintainer selects or sponsors a different parser boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt a shared tokenizer
recommendation.body: Create one stateful reasoning-tag tokenizer and migrate both complete-response and streaming consumers so visibility decisions cannot diverge.

likelyOwner.reason: The active candidate branch is assigned to and has been materially updated by steipete, who is best positioned to select its parser boundary.
